specials: Asarnil rides a Dragon. An extra +3 Attacks are added (included in Asarnil‘s profile). The Dragon can breath fire if the character has joined a unit that isn‘t engaged in combat. The fire breath has a range of 20cm and can be directed against one target as for normal shooting and has 3 Attacks that are worked out in the usual way. Additionally Asarnil causes terror in its enemies.
regiments-of-renown:asarnil-the-dragonlo.notes: The Dragon can fly increasing its rider‘s move to 100cm.
